title: Orb Of Valor
description: An epic adventure awaits — Play now!
fullStory:
Step into the boots of Moe, an archeologist on a solo expedition into centuries of forgotten ruins. But what begins as a routine dig unearths more than ancient stone — deep within, a sealed chamber hides a sleeping alien being and a strange, pulsating artifact that seems... alive, waiting to be held again.

The Creature wakes up from its slumber and you trigger the artifact in panic — only to be thrown across dimensions: from The land of towering dinosaurs, to the iron gates of a medieval palace, and into the shattered heart of a dystopian future. Each realm holds clues, dangers, and the lingering presence of the artifact — always disrupting life.
